entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Leader of the Weatherlight crew, prize of the Legacy, who fights Greven and Volrath.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Weatherlight navigator.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior of the Weatherlight crew who once thought Hanna a burden.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Whom Mirri follows; his blade kills Selenia, fulfilling a curse.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: A dark angel who freezes and is shattered by Crovax's blade.

entities.name: Tahli en-Dal
entities.description: A bounty hunter.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: A character whose sword flashed toward her father.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who seeks the pieces of the Legacy to be whole and was carried to the Predator by moggs.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A Samite healer who advises Gerrard.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Ruler of the stronghold in Rath, enemy of Gerrard and the kor, who influences the slivers.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: A commander who rules Vhati and the moggs and fights Gerrard.

entities.name: Vhati il-Dal
entities.description: A subordinate of Greven.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A minotaur of the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: A wizard adept taught meditation by Barrin.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Taught Ertai meditation.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin cabin hand.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Weatherlight captain, injured and relieved her ship is intact.

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: A soltari emissary.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Lord of Leaves.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: A speaker of loyalty to himself.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: An oracle who speaks prophecies.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: Llanowar emissary.

entities.name: Hans
entities.description: A character who says not again.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: Queen of the slivers whose children are part of her.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship of Gerrard's crew.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: Greven's ship, dragged behind the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: Collection of pieces Karn seeks, of which Gerrard is the prize.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane where the Weatherlight crew fights Volrath.

entities.name: Volrath's Stronghold
entities.description: Volrath's fortress, seed of a world's evil.

entities.name: Rootwater
entities.description: A watery region of Rath.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: Where Rofellos believes Mirri belongs.

entities.name: Skyshroud
entities.description: Forest of the elves.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A reclusive people brought together to destroy Volrath.

entities.name: Soltari
entities.description: A people at war with the dauthi.

entities.name: Dauthi
entities.description: Shadow people opposing the soltari.

entities.name: Moggs
entities.description: Goblins in Rath who serve Greven.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Hive creatures influenced by Volrath.

events.summary: Hanna and Mirri discuss how the slivers protect each other.
events.quote: We must learn how they protect each other.

events.summary: Takara shakes with guilt, knowing the last image her father saw was her sword flashing toward him.
events.quote: She knew the last image her father had seen was her sword flashing toward him.

events.summary: The Weatherlight drags the Predator behind it.
events.quote: dragged the Predator behind it, the cradle hauling the casket.

events.summary: Mirri apologizes to Hanna, saying she thought her a burden but was saved by her; Hanna accepts.
events.quote: I thought you a burden, and you saved my life.

events.summary: Gerrard draws his sword and rallies his crew against a foe.
events.quote: Gerrard grinned and drew his sword.

events.summary: Frozen by conscience, Karn does not resist as the moggs carry him to the Predator.
events.quote: Frozen by conscience, Karn did not resist as the moggs carried him to the Predator.

events.summary: Greven mocks Vhati's aim after the cannon fires at him.
events.quote: The cannon wasn't aimed at you!

events.summary: Gerrard tells Volrath he has his childhood wish and will now die.
events.quote: You've got your childhood wish at last.

events.summary: Mirri follows Crovax's skulking form, suspicious.
events.quote: All Mirri wanted to do was rest, but she couldn't ignore a nagging suspicion as she followed Crovax's skulking form.

events.summary: Squee swaps a warm ball for a pebble and hides.
events.quote: Squee tucked the warm ball in his pocket and slipped a pebble in its place.

events.summary: Orim tells Gerrard he is like the drake and must seem to glide effortlessly.
events.quote: Orim regarded Gerrard coolly.

events.summary: Gerrard asks Orim whether it is too late for prayer as sludge shifts in the Death Pits of Rath.
events.quote: I suppose," he said, "it's a little too late for prayer, isn't it?

events.summary: Selenia freezes and Crovax's blade kills her, shattering her like glass and fulfilling the curse as Crovax's mind collapses.
events.quote: For a sharp second, Selenia froze, and Crovax's blade found home.

events.summary: Greven lifts Vhati off his feet to punish his failure.
events.quote: lifted Vhati off his feet.

events.summary: Sisay is reassured by Gerrard that her ship is intact.
events.quote: Intact," Gerrard reassured her, "which is more than I can say for you, my friend.

events.summary: Sliver spines form a deadly hedge around the Weatherlight.
events.quote: Spans of spines leapt from one sliver to the next, forming a deadly hedge around the Weatherlight.

events.summary: Gerrard defeats Greven only by sacrificing any defense.
events.quote: Only by sacrificing any semblance of defense could Gerrard best Greven.

events.summary: Vhati watches a thunderhead from the Predator and sees Greven's mind in it.
events.quote: It is Greven's mind manifest.

events.summary: Karn explains to the sliver queen that he needs the pieces of the Legacy to be whole.
events.quote: We are kinfolk," explained Karn to the sliver queen.

events.summary: Lyna cries out that Ertai has opened the portal as Hanna's sword passes through her.
events.quote: In Barrin's name!

events.summary: Volrath's influence upon the slivers grows stronger when a counterfeit is accepted by the hive.
events.quote: When the clever counterfeit was accepted by the hive, Volrath's influence upon the slivers grew even stronger.

events.summary: Greven forbids moggs from operating telethopters after several are lost in collisions.
events.quote: After losing several of the devices to midair collisions, Greven forbade moggs from operating telethopters.

relations.note: Gerrard tells Volrath he will die

Only a matter as vital as destroying Volrath could bring together the reclusive kor people.
